calendarFeed.buttonHint: See the band's calendar in Google Calendar, Apple Calendar or Outlook
calendarFeed.title: Calendar in my own calendar app
calendarFeed.intro: Subscribe to the band's calendar from your personal calendar (Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, Outlook). Events show up there and update on their own.
calendarFeed.privateHint: This link is yours alone: anyone who has it can see the calendar. Don't share it.
calendarFeed.refreshHint: Google Calendar can take a few hours (up to about a day) to show changes. Apple and Outlook are usually faster.
calendarFeed.confirmRegenerate: Create a new link? The current one stops working and you'll need to subscribe again in your calendar.
calendarFeed.confirmRemove: Disconnect? The current link stops working and the events leave your calendar on its next refresh.
calendarFeed.membersOnly: Only band members can subscribe to the band's calendar.
calendarFeed.bandSettingsHint: They apply to every member's calendar.
calendarFeed.defaultDurationHint: Used for events that have a start time but no end.
